name: record_01
evidence: Each group contained two animals. Cynomolgus monkeys received 30 mg/kg IV. Minipigs received 12 mg/kg IV or 12 mg/kg SC. Table 18 reports exposure and clearance; no terminal half-life is given.

name: record_02
evidence: Monkey clearance was 0.16 mL/h/kg for ofaschlupfer and 0.467 mL/h/kg for bimagrumab. Minipig SC bioavailability was 93% and 45%, respectively.

name: record_03
evidence: Minipig IV AUCs were 25,900,000 and 24,200,000 ng·h/mL; SC AUCs were 24,100,000 and 10,900,000. Bioavailability was calculated from dose-normalized AUC. These are finite-cohort experimental estimates.
